restoration_note: The teaching describes how the four elemental faculties (στοιχεῖα) of the natural mind, when accommodated into the body, lay off their defiled garments in a cascading chain of stripping. The text gives a structured ladder of uncoverings (bond → wrath → desire → bitterness → heat → flesh → gloom → severity → winds of shame → eight ways of corruption → twelfold completion) which strongly constrains many small gaps as completions of named items in the chain. The editor's proposals for short morphological gaps (article, copula, prefix, single-letter completions) are accepted as high-confidence, since they are dictated by the formulaic 'ⲡⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ ⲙ̄X ⲡⲉ Y' refrain. Two larger lacunae (16 and 15 chars at section 4729–30) and the damaged closing sequence ({24}, {25}) lack constraint and are left unrestored. {11}, {14}, {15}, {21} are proposed at low confidence where partial traces narrow the field but do not fix the lexeme. The parallel between 'country of the Living Ones' (positive end) and 'X of sinners' (negative end) supports ⲧⲭⲱⲣⲁ for {23}.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor proposal accepted: ⲡⲉⲧⲥⲁⲧϥ̄ 'the chosen/elect one' is the standard Kephalaia vocative addressing the disciple. Parallel to lexicon ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ 'choose out, refine'.

4 chars beginning ⲧ-: ⲧⲙⲏⲉ 'the truth' fits as the object of ⲉⲓⲙⲉ ('know'); standard Manichaean phrase 'the brethren who knew the truth.' Spiritually fits the reading: those who recognize what is the Lord's.
Editor proposal accepted: ⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ 'mingled' is the technical cosmogonic verb (lexicon: mingling = unregenerate state where light and darkness not yet sorted). Subject ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ 'the Error' confirms.
Editor proposal accepted: circumstantial 3pl prefix ⲉⲩ- before ⲕⲁ-ⲕⲟⲩ 'leave them' yields the natural 'as they leave naked the defiled garments'.

4 chars beginning ⲛ-. Lexicon ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ 'sin' (the self's claim turned active). The reading describes the stripped defilements becoming a danger — they reveal themselves as sin operating against the body. Plausible but weakly constrained.
Editor proposal accepted: ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ 'the fire' (lexicon: fire = love that purifies; here the agent of stripping the defilement). Continues with -ⲉⲃⲁϣⲥ 'strips them' on next line.

Editor proposal accepted: ⲟ[ⲩⲥⲛ]ⲁϩ 'a bond' confirmed by line 18 'ⲡⲃⲱϣ ⲙ̄ⲡⲥⲛⲁϩ' ('the nakedness of the bond') which presupposes ⲥⲛⲁϩ as the previous link in the chain. Lexicon: ⲡⲥⲛⲁϩ = bond/chain (what holds soul in claimed state).
Editor proposal accepted: completes ⲡⲍⲙⲁⲙ 'the heat' (Lyc. ⲍⲙⲁⲙ = Sah. ϩⲙⲟⲙ), continuing from ⲡⲍ at line-end. The chain bitterness → heat → light's stripping → flesh fits the descending order.
Editor proposal accepted: completes ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϩ '(of) them' continuing from ⲙ̄- at previous line-end. Standard 3pl object form.
Editor proposal accepted: definite article ⲡ- to give [ⲡ]ⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ 'the stripping naked', formulaic refrain throughout this passage.
Editor proposal accepted: completes ⲁⲍⲏⲩ 'naked' continuing from ⲛ̄ⲕⲱⲕ ⲁ- at previous line-end. Part of the formulaic refrain.

Partial trace ⲛ̄ⲍⲣ_ⲟⲩ. Reading ⲛ̄-ⲍⲣⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'their flowers/sprouts' (Lyc. ⲍⲣⲏⲣⲉ) as the things produced by 'the tree' (ⲡϣⲏⲛ = perception in lexicon) of the winds of shame — disordered productions of perception. Fits trace but weakly constrained.
4 chars before ϣⲙ̄ⲛⲧ 'eight'. Required formula: 'ⲡⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ ⲛ̄X ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓ-ϣⲙⲛⲧ ⲙⲁⲓⲧ' = '...is the eight ways' (lexicon: ⲍⲧⲁⲩ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲓⲧ ⲉⲩⲥⲁⲧϩ — eight paths leading to corruption). Copula + demonstrative.

4 chars after ϣⲙ̄ⲛⲧ 'eight'. ⲙⲁⲓⲧ 'way/path' completes the lexicon-attested phrase 'eight ways' of corruption (the dark complement to four ways of regeneration). Constrained by structural map of the soul's options.

Editor's tentative ⲙⲓⲏ does not yield a clear lexeme. Continues ⲛ̄ⲧⲡ̄- from previous line, suggesting a noun for the deepest/twelfth term in the stripping chain, but without firm trace the lexeme cannot be fixed.
Partial ⲡⲥⲉ; 4 chars total. ⲡⲥⲉⲡ̄ 'the remainder/sum' fits as the final summing term: 'is the sum of these twelve strippings naked'. Weakly constrained.
16-char lacuna with no partial trace; introduces the new section about the four elements being gathered into the body. Length and absence of constraint preclude a confident fill.
15-char lacuna ending in -ⲁ before ⲡⲉⲧⲉϣⲁⲩⲥⲁⲩⲍⲟⲩ 'that which they gather'. No partial trace, no formulaic constraint to fix the connector phrase.
Editor proposal accepted: ⲟⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩ 'they bring them' (Lyc. ⲟⲛ̄ⲧ⸗ for ⲉⲓⲛⲉ). Habitual aspect fits the iterative description of the elements being gathered into the body.
Editor proposal accepted: relative marker ⲉⲧ- introducing 'those who come into the body'; confirmed by parallel ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲏⲩ later in the line.
Editor proposal accepted: completes ⲍⲛ̄ 'in' (Lyc. for ϩⲛ̄), governing 'their living icon' (= the New Man). Standard locative.

4 chars before visible ϩ; ϣⲁⲛⲏϩ 'forever/until eternity' would link 'they live' (end of previous line) with 'and they receive the Mind of Light'. Weakly constrained on dialect form (Lyc. usually ϣⲁⲉⲛⲉⲍ).
Editor proposal accepted: completes ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ ⲁ- 'upward to-' before ⲧⲭⲱⲣⲁ. Standard Manichaean directional idiom for ascent to the Land of Light.

8 chars; structural antithesis to the immediately preceding 'ⲧⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄' ('country of the Living Ones'). Here 'country of sinners' as the negative destination. Parallel construction strongly motivates the same noun.

1-char gap completing ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲧⲛ_ as a verb form, but the continuation on the next line (ⲥⲟ_) does not yield a clear compound. Cannot fix the letter without violating either the verb stem or the next word.
3 chars beginning ⲥⲟ-. Possibilities (ⲥⲟⲡ, ⲥⲟⲡⲥ̄, ⲥⲟⲩⲛⲉ etc.) cannot be discriminated, and the syntactic frame (verb taking 'in sins' as locative) is too flexible.
Editor proposal accepted: completes ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲅⲅⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ (Greek μετάγγισμός 'transmigration/decanting'), the term for transfer of state into another substrate (lexicon: metarrhismos).

english_restorations.basis: ⲡⲉⲧⲥⲁⲧϥ̄ = 'the chosen one/elect', vocative address to the disciple in Kephalaia.
ⲧⲙⲏⲉ = 'the truth' as object of ⲉⲓⲙⲉ ('know'); the brethren who recognized what is the Lord's.
ⲙⲟⲩⲭⲧ = lexicon's 'mingle' — the unregenerate state where light and darkness are not yet sorted.
ⲉⲩ- circumstantial 3pl prefix; English renders as 'as they' modifying the leaving-naked.
ⲛⲁⲃⲉ = lexicon's 'Sin', the self's claim turned active; the stripped defilements reveal themselves as sin operating against the body.
ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ = lexicon's 'fire' as love that purifies — the cosmic agent stripping the defilements.
ⲥⲛⲁϩ = lexicon's 'bond/chain' that holds the soul in its claimed state; confirmed by next line continuing the chain from this term.
ⲍⲣⲏⲣⲟⲩ = 'their flowers/sprouts' — what the tree (perception, lexicon ⲡϣⲏⲛ) produces; here the disordered productions of the winds of shame.
ⲙⲁⲓⲧ = lexicon's 'eight paths leading to corruption'; the structural map of the soul's options through the Zone.
Coptic gap unrestored; the deepest/twelfth term in the stripping chain cannot be fixed.
ⲡⲥⲉⲡ̄ = 'the remainder/sum total' of the twelve strippings — the floor of the whole sequence laying the natural mind open.
16-char Coptic lacuna unrestored; the introducing/transitional clause cannot be fixed.
15-char Coptic lacuna unrestored; the connector phrase cannot be fixed.
ⲟⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩ = 'they bring them' (Lyc. for ⲉⲓⲛⲉ); habitual aspect of the elements gathered for the body.
ⲉⲧ- relative marker rendered as 'those who'; confirmed by ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲏⲩ later in line.
ⲍⲛ̄ = locative 'in', governing 'their living icon' (= the New Man).
ϣⲁⲛⲏϩ = 'until eternity/forever', linking 'they live' with 'they receive the Mind of Light'. Weakly constrained.
ⲏⲓ̈ ⲁ completes ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ ⲁ- 'upward to-'; English renders the prepositional element 'to'.
ⲧⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲛ̄ = 'the country of-' in deliberate antithesis to 'country of the Living Ones' just preceding; the negative destination.
Coptic 1-char gap unrestored; the verb form cannot be fixed.
Coptic 3-char gap unrestored; the verb/noun governing 'in sins' cannot be discriminated.
